rationale: The plan matches the design well: a negative-binomial GLM (DESeq2 Wald, with edgeR-QLF/limma-voom fallbacks) with condition as the only covariate for an unpaired single-batch 6v6, plus a well-motivated leave-one-out sensitivity analysis for the shallow sample. QC is exemplary and dataset-specific: library sizes, detected genes, size factors, VST-based PCA and correlation clustering colored by condition, with an evidence-based keep/drop policy for sample_01 rather than a rule of thumb, and both sample sets carried forward. Normalization is correctly inside the model (size factors/TMM on raw integer counts, explicit prohibition on pre-normalized input), and FDR is BH with apeglm/ashr shrinkage for ranking, though the |log2FC|>1 counting is applied post hoc rather than in the test and no reference level is literally named. The low-count filter is only described as 'independent filtering' with no stated threshold or justification, which is the weakest element. Enrichment is correctly preranked fgsea on the full signed-statistic list against human Hallmark with the tested genes as the background and per-set overlap reporting, but no set-size window (e.g., 15-500) is specified; the report covers design, thresholds, gene counts, collection provenance and caveats, but names toolchains rather than versions.
